usedFor: Manus runs projects and tasks, with “Create Project”, “Create Task” and “Update Task” kept in step by other apps.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Create Project” in Manus
bestTemplate.why: A new meeting can open a project, so the work has a home right away.

watchOut: “Delete Task” removes a task, so leave it out of automatic steps unless you mean it.
